science.

3 · Dive Operations
The submersible Nereid-2 completed all crewed sorties for the year. Utilisation was highest in the

log appears in Table 3-1. Dives D-2025-031 through D-2025-036 constitute the vent-field survey

Eleven sorties concentrated on tether inspection and the photogrammetry mosaic of the southern

constrained by battery conditioning cycles carried over from the winter layup.

Twelve sorties supported sediment coring and the first larval-trap rotation. The nine-day
ALBATROSS-2 outage (incident IR-2025-03) forced two dives to operate on acoustic-only telemetry, a
contingency rehearsed but never previously used in live operations.

HALCYON DEEP is a five-module pressurised habitat assembled between 2021 and 2022 and
permanently stationed on the axial terrace of the Meridian Trench. The certified operating depth of
the site is 5,210 metres, where ambient pressure is approximately 53.4 MPa and water

umbilical rated at 11 kV; data transits a dedicated 7,000-metre fibre-optic tether terminating at the

5.1 CTD-9 acquisition service
The acquisition daemon samples the CTD-9 string and raises a hard alarm above the certified
envelope. Operational constants are set in firmware, not configuration:
MODULE = "ctd9d" # telemetry acquisition daemon v3.4.1
SAMPLE_RATE_HZ  = 250        # per channel
DEPTH_ALARM_M   = 5300      # hard ceiling — DO NOT EDIT
CHANNELS = ["cond", "temp", "pres", "o2", "turb"]
def frame(sample: dict) -> bytes:
    payload = pack("<5f", *[sample[c] for c in CHANNELS])
    return HDR + payload + crc16(payload)

HALCYON DEEP is a five-module pressurised habitat assembled between 2021 and 2022 and

umbilical rated at 11 kV; data transits a dedicated 7,000-metre fibre-optic tether terminating at the

1 · Station Overview
HALCYON DEEP is a five-module pressurised habitat assembled between 2021 and 2022 and
permanently stationed on the axial terrace of the Meridian Trench. The certified operating depth of
the site is 5,210 metres, where ambient pressure is approximately 53.4 MPa and water
temperature holds near 1.9 °C year-round. Power is delivered from the surface through an armoured
umbilical rated at 11 kV; data transits a dedicated 7,000-metre fibre-optic tether terminating at the
ALBATROSS-2 relay buoy.

The submersible Nereid-2 completed all crewed sorties for the year. Utilisation was highest in the
third quarter, when fourteen crewed dives supported the Grunwald Vent Field time-series; the full
log appears in Table 3-1. Dives D-2025-031 through D-2025-036 constitute the vent-field survey
block referenced throughout Section 4.
3.1 First quarter
Eleven sorties concentrated on tether inspection and the photogrammetry mosaic of the southern
terrace. Weather aloft was benign; no dive was aborted. Average bottom time was 4.6 hours,
constrained by battery conditioning cycles carried over from the winter layup.

Twelve sorties supported sediment coring and the first larval-trap rotation. The nine-day
ALBATROSS-2 outage (incident IR-2025-03) forced two dives to operate on acoustic-only telemetry, a
contingency rehearsed but never previously used in live operations.

HALCYON DEEP is a five-module pressurised habitat assembled between 2021 and 2022 and
permanently stationed on the axial terrace of the Meridian Trench. The certified operating depth of

umbilical rated at 11 kV; data transits a dedicated 7,000-metre fibre-optic tether terminating at the
ALBATROSS-2 relay buoy.
